audit_comment: APPENDIX 3: THE CLERICAL QUICK-REFERENCE CHARTS, BATCH FIVE - the D&DG walk round twenty-five, print pp. 140-141: the fifth batch of deity rows - Japanese (10), Melnibonean (15) - riding the roster data file, the Arioch row on the pdf 140 tail; the App 3 gap box stays open until the last chart batch lands. The print voice is the ROTATED tesseract pass, collated against the 1eonline L&L per-deity chart rows. The headline divergence: the print reads the Ama-Tsu-Mara form metalwork and place hearth where the L&L voice reads precious metalwork and temple - pinned by print, eyeball flag.

banner.title: Appendix 3: the clerical quick-reference chart, batch five - the D&DG walk round twenty-five, print pp. 140-141: the 25 rows of the Japanese and Melnibonean pantheons across the 13 printed columns.
banner.provenance: primary ink: the ROTATED extract/ddg tesseract pass (pNNN_rot_full.txt + pNNN_rot_tsv.tsv, pdf pages 140-141; the second printing) - the Arioch row rides the pdf 140 tail, the rest of the Melnibonean block rides pdf 141; the collation voice: the 1eonline L&L per-deity chart rows (the nnkuuurrrrcc and nuruah slugs run flat; the Tsukiyomi page header reads Sphere of Worship, the odd one). The adjudications: the Ama-Tsu-Mara metalwork + hearth pin (print over the L&L precious metalwork + temple, eyeball flag), the Daikoku wealth; luck sphere restored (the raunchiest garble of the rotated pass) with the name restored to the R861 Daikoku pin, the ten N-H-only Melnibonean rows (the geometry seats every single X at the N-H column; the L&L voice agrees), the Haaashastaak animal lizard, dinosaur pinned (the L&L shifts the columns), the L&L [swan]/[tiger]/[whale] brackets noted as gloss markers, the Hachiman equinox and Ebisu brown robes folds restored, and the Roofdrak and Grome stray glyphs noted. The batch order runs Japanese, Melnibonean.
